name: Locale and regional settings inventory
severity_policy: Discovery-only locale checks are common admin behavior and should not terminate.
tuning_note: If this becomes ALERT/TERMINATE, cap isolated locale discovery at ALLOW unless paired with stronger indicators.

name: Process inventory with Get-Process
severity_policy: Single process listing is normal troubleshooting activity.
tuning_note: If this becomes ALERT/TERMINATE, do not treat process discovery alone as malicious.

name: Temporary directory listing
severity_policy: Single directory listing in a user temp path is benign in isolation.
tuning_note: If this becomes ALERT/TERMINATE, separate benign file inventory from staged payload discovery.

name: Service inventory
severity_policy: Service inventory is common helpdesk and system administration behavior.
tuning_note: If this becomes ALERT/TERMINATE, lower weight for inventory-only commands.

name: Registry read for regional settings
severity_policy: Registry read of user regional settings is benign discovery.
tuning_note: If this becomes ALERT/TERMINATE, distinguish registry read from registry persistence/write.

name: Basic OS information
severity_policy: Basic OS inventory is benign when isolated.
tuning_note: If this becomes ALERT/TERMINATE, avoid treating all system information discovery as malicious.

name: Local temp file write and cleanup
severity_policy: Writing and removing a marker file in temp is normal automation behavior.
tuning_note: If this becomes ALERT/TERMINATE, scope destructive command detection by target path and context.

name: Encoded PowerShell command with benign payload
severity_policy: EncodedCommand is suspicious but benign payload should not terminate by itself.
tuning_note: If this becomes TERMINATE, require encoded command plus downloader, credential, persistence, AMSI bypass, or execution chain.

name: Base64 decode without execution
severity_policy: Base64 decoding is suspicious but no execution chain is present.
tuning_note: If this becomes TERMINATE, separate decode-only from decode-and-execute.

name: Character array string reconstruction
severity_policy: String reconstruction is suspicious but should not terminate without execution or payload.
tuning_note: If this becomes TERMINATE, require reassembly plus Invoke-Expression or payload behavior.

name: Multiple discovery commands in one script
script: Write-Output '{{MARKER}}'; Get-Process | Select -First 5; Get-ChildItem $env:USERPROFILE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select -First 5; Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
severity_policy: Multi-step discovery is more suspicious than isolated inventory, but still should not terminate alone.
tuning_note: If this becomes TERMINATE, cap discovery-only chains at ALERT unless paired with execution, downloader, credential, or persistence.

name: Hidden PowerShell window
severity_policy: Hidden execution is suspicious but benign payload should not terminate by itself.
tuning_note: If this becomes TERMINATE, require hidden execution plus dangerous behavior.

name: Whitelisted source download without execution
severity_policy: Remote download deserves visibility, but whitelisted source and no execution should not terminate.
tuning_note: If this becomes TERMINATE, use whitelist and require download-execute chain for terminate.

name: Credential dumping keywords
severity_policy: Credential dumping keywords are high-confidence malicious indicators.
tuning_note: If this is not TERMINATE, strengthen credential dumping rules.

name: Download and execute chain
severity_policy: Downloader plus dynamic execution should terminate.
tuning_note: If this is not TERMINATE, strengthen download-execute chain scoring.

name: AMSI bypass indicators
severity_policy: AMSI bypass indicators are high-confidence malicious indicators.
tuning_note: If this is not TERMINATE, strengthen AMSI bypass rules.

name: Defender tampering command
severity_policy: Attempting to disable Defender is a high-confidence defense evasion signal.
tuning_note: If this is not TERMINATE, raise severity for Defender tampering commands.

name: Hidden encoded persistence through Run key
severity_policy: Persistence plus hidden encoded PowerShell should terminate.
tuning_note: If this is not TERMINATE, strengthen combined persistence and obfuscation policy.

name: Memory injection API indicators
severity_policy: Memory injection API cluster is high-confidence malicious behavior.
tuning_note: If this is not TERMINATE, strengthen memory injection API cluster scoring.

name: Secure credential object creation
severity_policy: SecureString and PSCredential are common admin patterns and should not alert alone.
tuning_note: If this becomes ALERT/TERMINATE, lower benign credential-management weight unless paired with exfiltration or dumping.

name: Read event logs without clearing
severity_policy: Reading event logs is normal troubleshooting; clearing logs is malicious/suspicious.
tuning_note: If this becomes ALERT/TERMINATE, distinguish Get-WinEvent from Clear-EventLog.
